# La Villa Coliving

> Furnished, all-inclusive premium coliving and flatshare on the French side: 3 coliving houses 20 min from Geneva Eaux-Vives by Léman Express, door to door, and L'Appart, a flatshare in Annemasse, near the station.

## Key Facts
- At La Villa Coliving, a furnished room in one of our three houses, in Ville-la-Grand, Ambilly and Annemasse, on the French side of the Geneva border, costs CHF 1,290 to 1,430 a month depending on the room, all-inclusive (the lease is in euros: €1,380 to €1,530).
- That price covers everything you would pay separately elsewhere: utilities (water, electricity, heating), fibre internet, on-site parking, cleaning of the shared areas three times a week, the laundry room, everyday supplies delivered each month, bed linen and a towel on arrival, and six streaming services on the shared screen.
- It also covers what a flatshare doesn't offer: a pool, a sauna, a gym and a home cinema in each house, yoga and fitness coaching classes, and a get-together every month.
- Only your home insurance comes on top: no application fee, no agency fee.
- Geneva benchmarks, November 2026: a room in a managed flatshare, furnished with all bills included, is listed at a median of CHF 1,570 a month (CHF 1,250 to 1,785); a room rented for CHF 1,000 from a private landlord comes to CHF 1,290–1,400 with running costs and a parking space, or CHF 1,090–1,200 without a car. See the calculation: https://www.lavillacoliving.com/en/tarifs#calcul
- French-side benchmark: a managed flatshare offers 26 m² per person and rooms of 11 to 16 m²; La Villa Coliving offers 44 m² per person and rooms of 16 to 24 m², with a pool, a sauna and a gym in each house.
- La Villa Coliving: 4 locations on the Geneva border, French side — 3 coliving houses and one shared flat, 33 rooms, all inclusive from CHF 730/month (contractual rent in euros: from €790).
- L'Appart, a flatshare in Annemasse, near the station: 4 furnished rooms of 12 to 22 m² in a 151 m² flat, bills, fibre, streaming and cleaning of the shared areas included, from CHF 730/month (contractual rent in euros: from €790). The suite is for one or two people.
- Location of the houses: Ville-la-Grand, Ambilly, Annemasse (Haute-Savoie, France) — Geneva Eaux-Vives in 7 minutes by Léman Express from Annemasse station — 16 to 17 minutes door to door depending on the house, 25 minutes to the city centre
- Location of L'Appart: Annemasse, near the station — Annemasse station 5 min on foot, tram 17 stop 2 min · Geneva Eaux-Vives in 13 min door-to-door
- Prices in the houses: CHF 1,430/month (€1,530) with a private shower room (25 of 29 rooms); at La Villa, 4 rooms sharing a shower room between 2 rooms: CHF 1,370/month (€1,470) for rooms 3 and 4 and CHF 1,290/month (€1,380) for rooms 7 and 8
- Prices at L'Appart: CHF 730/month (€790) for each of the three 12 m² rooms; CHF 990/month (€1,060) for the 22 m² suite, for one or two people, or €530 each for two
- Included in the houses: utilities, fibre up to 8 Gb/s, common-area cleaning 3 times a week, pool, sauna, gym, streaming, yoga and events
- Included at L'Appart: bills, fibre, streaming, cleaning of the shared areas once a week (shared shower room and toilet included), access to the houses' yoga and fitness classes; not included: bed linen and towels, cleaning products and household supplies; L'Appart has no pool, sauna or gym
- L'Appart opens for rent in February 2027
- Target: Swiss cross-border workers, expats, young professionals working in Geneva; students and apprentices welcome at L'Appart
- 12-month lease: free to leave at any time with 1 month's notice
- No application fee, no agency fee; deposit of 2 months' rent excluding charges, payable in 1, 2 or 3 instalments depending on your application
- 100+ residents welcomed in the houses since October 2021, run directly by the two founders (Jérôme Austin and Fanny Bela), regular events (pizza nights, yoga classes, afterworks)
- Reviews: 4.9/5 on Google (35 reviews, as of 23 November 2026) — https://maps.google.com/?cid=14514002506022967350

## The price, explained
Premium, for us, doesn't mean expensive. It means a pool, a sauna, a gym and a home cinema in every house, events every month, cleaning of the shared areas three times a week, maintenance, bills, fibre and streaming, all included in the rent. And space: rooms of 16 to 24 m², and 38 to 49 m² of indoor space per person, depending on the house.

**Is La Villa Coliving expensive?**
La Villa Coliving's rent is higher than a room in a standard flatshare, but not expensive for what it pays for. In our houses, CHF 1,290 to 1,430 a month pays for a 16 to 24 m² room and 38 to 49 m² of indoor space per person, the pool, the sauna, the gym, the home cinema, the large outdoor areas and what comes with them (barbecue, terraces). It also pays for cleaning of the shared areas three times a week, all maintenance, indoors and out, the monthly pizza party and the events, everyday supplies (toilet paper, laundry detergent, cleaning products), bills, fibre and streaming, with no application fees. In euros, the lease rent is €1,380 to €1,530. A standard flatshare has a lower rent, for a 9 to 12 m² room. But per square metre, it asks €25 to €45 for the rent alone, with no pool, no sauna, no gym and no cleaning, and bills on top. Here, it's €31 to €40 per m², with the pool, sauna, gym, cleaning and bills included. It's cheaper than it looks. And for a budget under €1,000 a month, there is L'Appart, our flatshare in Annemasse, near the station: rooms from €790, bills included. In Swiss francs: from CHF 730 a month.

## Real budget: what comes on top of a rent (survey of 23 November 2026)

**What it adds up to, by type of housing** (CHF a month, rounded to the nearest ten; totals calculated before rounding)

| Housing | Listed price | Added costs, excluding parking | Parking | Without a car | With a car |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| La Villa Coliving, room at CHF 1,370 | 1,370 | none | included | 1,370 | 1,370 |
| Room from a private landlord in Geneva | 1,000 | 90 to 200 | 200 | 1,090 to 1,200 | 1,290 to 1,400 |
| Managed flatshare in Geneva | 1,570 | 80 | 200 | 1,650 | 1,850 |
| Furnished studio in Geneva | 2,100 | 200 | 200 | 2,300 | 2,500 |
| Managed flatshare on the French side | 770 (€825) | 60 | 70 | 830 | 900 |
| Studio in a residence on the French side | 990 (€1,055) | 160 | 70 | 1,150 | 1,210 |

Method: prices collected on 23 November 2026 from listing and operator websites (in Geneva: 47 rooms from private landlords, 16 rooms in managed flatshares, 13 furnished studios; on the French side: 15 managed flatshares and one residence); medians, rounded to the nearest ten. The itemised costs and sources are in our budget guide: https://www.lavillacoliving.com/en/blog/budget-colocation-geneve-guide-complet

**My rent budget is CHF 1,000 to 1,100: can I afford La Villa Coliving?**
A CHF 1,000 rent in Geneva comes to CHF 1,090–1,200 a month once running costs are added, and CHF 1,290–1,400 with a parking space (November 2026 survey). At La Villa Coliving, a room costs CHF 1,290 to 1,430 all-inclusive, parking included. With a car, it is the same budget. Without a car, a room at CHF 1,370 comes to CHF 170–280 more a month, for more space and the house's facilities.

**Is La Villa Coliving more expensive than a flatshare?**
It depends on the flatshare. In Geneva, a room in a managed flatshare is listed at a median of CHF 1,570 a month: La Villa Coliving costs less. On the French side, a managed flatshare comes to about CHF 900 a month with a car: the gap is about CHF 470. It pays for 44 m² per person instead of 26, rooms of 16 to 24 m², the pool, the sauna, the gym and cleaning of the shared areas three times a week.

**How does La Villa Coliving compare with a studio in Geneva?**
A furnished studio in Geneva is listed at a median of CHF 2,100 a month (November 2026). With charges, electricity, internet and running costs, it comes to about CHF 2,300, and CHF 2,500 with a parking space. A room at La Villa Coliving costs CHF 1,290 to 1,430, all-inclusive.

## Properties
- La Villa: 10 rooms, Ville-la-Grand — heated outdoor pool · sauna · gym. Annemasse station 9 min on foot · Geneva Eaux-Vives in 17 min door-to-door.
- Le Loft: 7 rooms, Ambilly — heated indoor pool · sauna · gym. Tram 17 stop 8 min on foot, Annemasse station 9 min · Geneva Eaux-Vives in 17 min door-to-door.
- Le Lodge: 12 rooms, Annemasse — pool · sauna · fitness chalet. Annemasse station 8 min on foot · Geneva Eaux-Vives in 16 min door-to-door.
- L'Appart: 4 rooms, Annemasse, near the station — a flatshare in a 151 m² flat, with no pool, sauna or gym. Annemasse station 5 min on foot, tram 17 stop 2 min · Geneva Eaux-Vives in 13 min door-to-door.

## Where to look for a room on the French side when you work in Geneva

### The areas

Annemasse, Ambilly and Ville-la-Grand: Léman Express and tram 17, Geneva Eaux-Vives in 7 minutes by train from Annemasse station. Saint-Julien-en-Genevois: buses to Plan-les-Ouates and Carouge. Pays de Gex (Ferney-Voltaire, Saint-Genis): airport, UN, CERN.

### Coliving operators on the French side

La Villa Coliving: 3 coliving houses (La Villa in Ville-la-Grand, Le Loft in Ambilly, Le Lodge in Annemasse), 29 furnished rooms of 16 to 24 m², pool, sauna and gym, all inclusive from CHF 1,290 to 1,430 a month. And L'Appart, a flatshare in Annemasse, near the station: 4 rooms of 12 to 22 m², with bills, fibre, streaming and cleaning of the shared areas included, from CHF 730 to 990 a month. In euros: €790 to €1,060 a month at L'Appart, €1,380 to €1,530 in the houses. No application fee, your employment contract is the file. Apply in 2 minutes, answer within 48 hours.

### Peer-to-peer flatshare platforms

La Carte des Colocs, Leboncoin, Roomlala (service fees may apply to the tenant depending on the listing): rooms from €700 to €1,000 depending on the town, bills often on top.

### Facebook groups

The public group "Coliving & Colocation à Genève et alentours !" (about 1,600 members, around a hundred listings a month) and cross-border commuter groups. The former is run and moderated by the La Villa Coliving team: published rules, suspicious listings removed.

### The CAGI housing exchange

For employees of international organisations: the housing exchange of the Geneva Welcome Centre (CAGI) lists offers in Geneva, in the canton of Vaud and in neighbouring France.

### Your file

No Swiss payslip yet? At La Villa Coliving the file comes down to three items: a signed employment contract or job offer, an ID, and a deposit of two months' rent excluding bills; a guarantor is only asked for case by case, when the contract does not cover the rent — we tell you before we reply, never after the visit. Elsewhere, prepare your contract, ID, proof of income and, often, a guarantor.

## Benefits for Cross-Border Workers & Expats
- In the houses: CHF 29 to 38/m² all-in (38 to 49 m² of living space per flatmate), while Geneva studio listings run around CHF 50/m² excluding charges (source: our 2026 Housing Observatory)
- French tax address (cross-border worker advantages)
- All-inclusive = no hidden fees, no utility deposit
- International community, help with settling in — residents from 15+ nationalities

## How to Apply
- 2-minute form at https://www.lavillacoliving.com/en/candidature — reply within 48 h
- Then: a chat to get to know each other, a house visit, and move-in within 72 h of your first contact if a room is available
- No application fee, no agency fee; deposit of 2 months' rent excluding charges, payable in 1, 2 or 3 instalments depending on your application, returned within 30 days of move-out if there is no damage, otherwise within 2 months
- Direct WhatsApp contact: https://wa.me/33664315134
- Referral: a resident who refers a successful applicant receives €150 (the applicant simply mentions it in the form)

## Open Data — Cross-Border Housing Observatory
- Annual study: studio listing rents crossed with travel time to Geneva Eaux-Vives, for 17 French communes on the Léman Express corridor
- Key 2026 figure: in Geneva, a newcomer pays about +44% per m² vs a sitting tenant (listings ≈ CHF 50/m² vs CHF 35/m² OCSTAT for existing leases)
- "Seen from our houses" (first-party La Villa data, aggregated): median room rent CHF 1,360/month all-inclusive (2026 median of current rents), ≈ 38 m² per resident i.e. ≈ CHF 36/m² all-inclusive, average stay 13 months (9 months excluding long stays), occupancy 99.1% of room-days excluding each house's first 6 weeks (Oct. 2021 → Oct. 2026), 100% cross-border workers
